gen-dafont-over-there-fs-quicksand: Over There looks drawn with a fixed-width nib, spaced generously. It carries the vintage-military authority, while Quicksand, a plain sans with tall bulb-like bowls, does the approachable talking.
gen-dafont-over-there-gf-aleo: Aleo is dignified and classic, its counters letting the eye slip in and out. Aleo would carry a long run of text with an easy in-and-out glide, while Over There stays the commanding vintage-military voice above.
gen-dafont-over-there-gf-almendra-sc: Over There draws every line like smooth, rounded tubing. It brings the vintage-military command, while Almendra SC, a serif with mouths that stay open, supplies the dignified, authoritative reading voice.
gen-dafont-over-there-gf-antic-slab: Over There leads with vintage-military command and a fixed-width nib look. Antic Slab brings round bowls and wide, barely curled s curves, so paragraphs would feel dignified and editorial.
gen-dafont-over-there-gf-belgrano: Commanding and vintage-military, Over There looks drawn with a fixed-width nib. Belgrano, a traditional text serif whose curves stay open, is the counterpart to heading stems that carry no hairlines at all.
gen-dafont-over-there-gf-biorhyme: Over There has a pencil-line consistency, vintage-military and commanding, with a fixed-width nib look. BioRhyme, a bookish serif with widely spaced capitals, deserves a slightly more generous size.
gen-dafont-over-there-gf-biorhyme-expand: Reading here feels refined and bookish, each word broken into single letters by open gaps. BioRhyme Expanded does that work under Over There, whose nib-drawn, vintage-military lines show no thick-thin shift.
gen-dafont-over-there-gf-biz-udmincho: Over There draws a plain, unshaded line that never swells, vintage-military and commanding. But BIZ UDMincho, a bookish serif with shallow terminal curls and wide gaps, supplies the traditional detail the heading lacks.
gen-dafont-over-there-gf-copse: Stern and widely spaced, Over There draws n arches the same weight as its stems. Copse, a literary serif with daylight through every curve, gives that commanding heading its most striking foil, openness.
gen-dafont-over-there-gf-cutive: Over There looks bent from a single length of wire. Cutive, a refined serif with wide tracking in running text and a generous c opening, probably wants a little more size than usual.
